wildbosses.help.spawn: Force-spawns a boss using Cobblemon Pokémon properties. Example: /wb spawn epic exeggutor alolan. respectCooldown defaults to false; append respectCooldown=true to test the real cooldown gate.
wildbosses.help.list: Lists every currently active boss with species, tier, position, and UUID.
wildbosses.help.info: Shows a boss's tier, level, shiny status, and position.
wildbosses.help.teleport: Teleports you to the given boss.
wildbosses.help.despawn: Force-despawns a specific boss and cleans up its registry/glow.
wildbosses.help.forcebattle: Immediately starts a battle with the given boss.
wildbosses.help.loot: Gives you the items from a tier's loot table directly, bypassing combat.
wildbosses.help.reload: Reloads datapacks (e.g. after editing a loot table JSON).
wildbosses.help.glow: Re-applies tier glow/team color to a boss.
wildbosses.help.tier: Changes an already-spawned boss's tier (updates tags, glow, and registry).
wildbosses.help.killall: Despawns every active boss and clears the registry.
wildbosses.help.cooldown: Checks whether you're currently on boss-spawn cooldown.
wildbosses.help.leaderboard: Shows the top 10 boss hunters overall, or for a specific tier.
wildbosses.help.reloadconfig: Re-reads config/wildbosses/wildbosses.json without restarting the server.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.wildbosses: Rare, dynamically scaled Boss Pokémon for Cobblemon.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.wildbosse: Adds roaming Boss Pokémon with five tiers, dynamic level scaling, smarter battle AI, Enrage, tiered loot, Mega Evolution support, persistent cooldowns, advancements, and leaderboards.
wildbosses.config.title: WildBosses Configuration
wildbosses.config.category.general.desc: Core spawn, cooldown, lifetime, and level-scaling settings. Dedicated servers always use the server-side config.
wildbosses.config.category.battle.desc: Controls Rare+ Enrage and Boss combat behavior. Enable AI debug logging here when testing decisions and stat scaling.
wildbosses.config.category.species.desc: Controls which Cobblemon species labels are blocked from becoming Bosses.
wildbosses.config.category.tiers.desc: Per-tier rarity, scaling, AI, shiny, IV, and Mega Evolution settings.
wildbosses.config.tier.desc: These values only apply when a Boss rolls this tier.
wildbosses.config.option.boss_spawn_chan: Chance that an eligible wild spawn becomes a Boss. Default: 0.1953125%, or 1 in 512.
How long a player waits after causing a Boss spawn before they can cause another one. Saved as ticks in the JSON.
wildbosses.config.option.boss_lifetime.d: How long an untouched Boss roams before despawning. Saved as ticks in the JSON.
wildbosses.config.option.max_scaled_leve: Hard cap for a Boss level after party scaling and tier bonus are applied.
wildbosses.config.option.enrage_interval: Turns between Enrages for Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic Bosses. The warning comes one turn before.
wildbosses.config.option.enrage_stages.d: Stat stages gained on each Enrage by Rare+ Bosses. Battle stat stages still cap at +6.
wildbosses.config.option.excluded_labels: Comma-separated Cobblemon labels. Matching species can never become Bosses. Keep at least one label here.
wildbosses.config.option.tier_weight.des: Relative chance for this tier after a spawn has already been selected as a Boss. This is not the global Boss spawn chance.
wildbosses.config.option.tier_level_bonu: Levels added to the challenger’s strongest Pokémon. Defaults now run from +5 to +25 because Boss AI, IVs, Enrage, and Mega Evolution already add plenty of pressure.
wildbosses.config.option.tier_ai_skill.d: Boss aggression skill from 0 to 5. Higher values improve KO recognition, move scoring, and access to aggressive setup/recovery behavior.
wildbosses.config.option.tier_shiny_chan: Chance for a Boss in this tier to become shiny.
wildbosses.config.option.tier_perfect_iv: When enabled, Bosses in this tier spawn with perfect IVs.
wildbosses.config.option.tier_mega_chanc: Chance for a compatible Boss in this tier to Mega Evolve during battle. Mega Stones are awarded only when Mega Evolution actually happens, once per species per player.
wildbosses.config.option.boss_ai_debug.d: Logs move scores, estimated damage, KO checks, setup/recovery decisions, and the final Boss move every turn. Leave this off for normal play.
wildbosses.command.error.invalid_respect: respectCooldown must be true or false.
